notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello dear adventurers![/b]

Please take a moment to read this carefully — this update is important for the future of the project.

Today, several characters' abilities have been reworked and rebalanced. Their order in the menus has also been reorganized to make them easier to find. This update had become necessary: originally, the game was supposed to end with the main quest. But we've now gone six times further, with seven complex and varied quests. The abilities created at the beginning of the project were simply not designed for that kind of progression.

If you're continuing an existing save — especially if you're level 20 or higher — you might notice that Mononc and Psycho’s skills have been corrupted by this update. Other characters are also affected, but the issues are less visible.

It was a necessary evil, and I apologize for the inconvenience.

To fix this, I’ve added a debug option. Go see GrosEgo at the refuge on Matawin Island — he’ll offer to reset your characters based on their current level. This way, your progress is preserved, and you’ll be able to benefit from the newly balanced abilities.

Be sure to save before talking to him (better safe than sorry), and unequip your characters so you don’t risk losing your hard-earned gear.

This debug option only applies to saves started on an older version. New games are not affected.

Thank you for your understanding, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update 3.0 Faraway Lands
notes.content:
The update "Faraway Lands" is finally available!
This one sees the arrival of a new archipelago. 
-5 new islands to explore.
-A new 5 hour quest, available when you have completed the main quest and found 20 treasures.
-Original stories, optional dungeons and many other surprises!
-Fixed some small bugs from the previous version.
-Updates will follow soon to add additional content.

I remain listening for your advice and suggestion,
Have fun!
Mononc

notes.title: Update 2.6.3
notes.content:
Update 2.6.3 is ready!

This brings many new features;

-A new island to explore located in the East of the Great Gardens Island. This includes 3 mansions, two dungeons and a crypt. A secondary quest of about 3 hours is hidden, you can discover it!

-New skills for several characters, some acquired by levelling, others by discovering magazines.

-Several new weapons and armor.

-A new enemy community.

-The table is set for the addition of new quests that will follow in a future update. 

I remain listening for your advice and suggestions!

Good game! 

Mononc
